scientific_question: Which of predictive transformation, memory, learned structure, hierarchy and adaptive computation cause complete-task gains?
execution_policy: Preserve original failures; no TEST, promotion, external communication or merge; all ordinary internal-research work remains authorized within qualified data/compute gates. No future process is implied by this registry.

experiments.name: Baseline/checkpoint reproduction
experiments.models: All three original exact10M initial/final checkpoints
experiments.required: Recount, all original cold/state/prediction/language replay; hashes and data provenance

experiments.name: Factorized memory attribution
experiments.required: 32-factorial state resets, legal donors, bank shuffles, continuous bank disabling, query-only and direct-history controls, exact task outcomes; new delayed-cue/oracle task remains a separate dependency

experiments.name: Matched trained memory-free/memory-enabled predictors
experiments.required: A0/A1/A2 scratch fits with fully active matched capacity, source/data/order/exposure/compute, frozen objectives and current/hidden/generalization regimes; inference ablation is not separately trained A1

experiments.name: Matched-depth stacking
experiments.required: Depth1/2/4/8 associative and non-associative controls, matched parameters then measured compute; new graphs need exact Python/Lean references and preflight

experiments.name: Learned hierarchy
experiments.required: A3/A4 upward/downward/slow/cross-level interventions; held-out transformation, invariance and complete success; no human concept labels used as discovered structure

experiments.name: Adaptive representation
experiments.required: Bytes/conventional tokens/discrete learned tokens/continuous patches/controller; block raw-byte bypass, preserve rare spelling and code; source bytes/sec and tokens/sec separately

experiments.name: Structure discovery/reuse/composition
experiments.required: Held-out families, parameters, combinations and executable transformations; oracle-query solvability, wrong structures/slot knockout/surface changes, complete success

experiments.name: Throughput/FLOPs/state efficiency
experiments.required: Same-host trained A0 prefill/decode, clamped-state interventions and replay costs now; genuine A1-A6 comparisons pending those trained candidates. Energy only if instrumented

experiments.name: Independent protected replication
experiments.required: Independent access-separated assessor, protected-source authorization and signer; author cannot self-certify independence or open TEST

experiments.name: Evidence-gated integrated architecture
experiments.required: Only mechanisms with independently established exact-task and quality/compute gains may enter A6; no blind combination or scale-up

scale: Original10M models are frozen references. No blanket waiver of parameter/comparison gates is inferred for new candidates; exact scope and budgets must be registered before any optimizer step. 50M+ only after quality/compute evidence.
